name: Corporate Action Information 1
definition: General information about the corporate action event.

IssuerCorporateActionIdentification.name: Issuer Corporate Action Identification
IssuerCorporateActionIdentification.definition: Reference given to the event by the CA event issuer (agent).

CorporateActionProcessingIdentification.name: Corporate Action Processing Identification
CorporateActionProcessingIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

MandatoryVoluntaryEventType.name: Mandatory Voluntary Event Type
MandatoryVoluntaryEventType.definition: Specifies whether the event is mandatory, mandatory with options or voluntary.

EventProcessingType.name: Event Processing Type
EventProcessingType.definition: Type of processing involved by a Corporate Action.

UnderlyingSecurity.name: Underlying Security
UnderlyingSecurity.definition: Identification of the underlying financial instrument, ie, the financial instrument affected by the corporate action event.

CorporateActionIdentificationRule.definition: At least one element in the list (IssuerCorporateActionReference, OfficialCorporateActionReference, CorporateActionProcessingIdentifier) must be present. They may all be may be present.
